name: Sanguinai
body:
Sanguinai, sometimes called bloodlings, are a rare half-breed race sometimes mistaken for a dhampir. Sanguinai are the result of a union between an aedvectis and a humanoid. While rarely tolerated by their monstrous parents, Sanguinai sometimes survive either by sheer luck or by caprice of a particular aedvectis that brought them into the world. While aedvecti never act as parents to sanguinai, it is much more often that one born from a humanoid mother survives to adulthood, as aedvecti fathers are more prone to indifference towards the bastard child. Mothers of that monstrous race are very rarely interested in carrying the baby to term, unless for some reason believing the unborn child to be an aedvectis itself, in which case more often than not the mother will slay the newborn out of rage right after its birth.

At first glance, sanguinai are mostly similar to their nonmonstrous parent’s race. They tend to be frail of body but keen of mind, with notably long noses and distinct aging pattern. While they physically mature only slightly slower than humans, achieving adulthood around 20 years of age, they tend to always look at least twice or thrice their years, with teenage sanguinai looking middle-aged and adult ones often already looking old. It is not uncommon for a freshly mature sanguinai to be bald, hunched over and covered in wrinkly skin. This has no apparent effect on their actual lifespan, which in most cases can easily last over 200 years, and in cases of sanguinai born of long-lived races like elves, much longer than that. Sanguinai, due to their heritage, have a great affinity for blood magic and tend to be able to control it easily. Many sanguinai are capable of casting basic magic even if they otherwise don’t command any other arcane or divine powers. Their powerful minds are also highly drawn to the occult, ancient or eldritch knowledge and the black arts. Even sanguinai living simple, mundane lives are often passionate about magical or religious theory not fit for their lifestyle. Those able to afford and pursue their interests often become great spellcasters of various types, though sadly most often tend to be invested in their darker facets. This is especially noteworthy because aedvecti themselves are not known to be either commonly interested in magic or knowledgeable about such topics in general, so it is unknown why sanguinai are drawn so strongly to such pursuits.

Sanguinai are carnivores, like the aedvecti, but are most often either by need or conviction more civil about it, eating barely cooked animal flesh and blood. Their teeth are needle-like and sharp, similar to their forebears’ and some sanguinai are able to drain the blood from living creatures as skillfully as these monsters. The sanguinai are also noted to occasionally become carriers to many of the same diseases that mosquitos carry, themselves being somehow unaffected by them.

While they often try their best to fit into their adopted societies, sanguinai are frequently discriminated against due to their interests, looks, diet and perceived association with their monstrous ancestors. Still, most sanguinai are calm and patient, willing to overlook such behavior and quietly earn their place in life. While sanguinai often forgive, they rarely forget, and those of more evil nature may enact retribution after ascending to power.

Standard Racial Traits (17 RP)
Ability Score Racial Traits: Sanguinai are feeble, but their minds are incredibly sharp. They gain +2 Intelligence, +2 Wisdom, and –2 Strength.
Type: Sanguinai are humanoids with the Human subtype
Size: Sanguinai are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
Base Speed: Sanguinai have a base speed of 30 feet.
Languages: Sanguinai begin play speaking Common. Sanguinai with high Intelligence scores can choose any languages they want (except secret languages, such as Druidic).
Feat and Skill Racial Traits
Skilled: Every Sanguinai chooses two skills from Knowledge (arcana, planes or religion), Spellcraft and Use Magic Device. He gains a +2 racial bonus on both of those skills, and those skills are treated as class skills regardless of what class he actually takes.
Magical Racial Traits
Blood Affinity: Sanguinai gain +1 DC to resist any blood spells they cast and they cast them at a +1 CL. A blood spell is any spell which either includes “blood” in its name, or any other spell that relies on blood, at GM discretion. Sanguinai with a Wisdom score of 13 or higher also gain the following spell-like abilities (the caster level is equal to their character level):

1/day—bleed, detect magic, touch of fatigue.

Offense Racial Traits
Bite: Sanguinai gain a primary bite attack that deals 1d4 damage.
Senses Racial Traits
Darkvision: Sanguinai can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.
Scent: Sanguinai have the scent special ability.
Alternate Racial Traits

The following alternate racial traits may be selected in place of one or more of the standard racial traits above. Consult your GM before selecting any of these options.

Dissociation Mist: Some sanguinai partly inherit the aedvecti ability to secrete a mind-altering substance into the air. Any living creatures within 10 feet of such sanguinai take a -2 penalty on Wisdom-based skill checks against them. This racial trait replaces the blood affinity racial trait.
Echo of Hunger: Some sanguinai can call on the hunger of their forebears to quench their thirst with the blood of living beings. Such sanguinai gain the ability to cast vampiric hunger once per day as a spell-like ability, although they can only target themselves with this ability. This racial trait replaces the scent racial trait.
Scholar: Some sanguinai push aside their fascination with magic and instead focus on other scholarly pursuits. Such sanguinai gain the skill focus with any knowledge skill as a bonus feat. This racial trait replaces the skilled racial trait.
